These are actual Markdown files saved by the existing VS Code custom editor during the approved native recording on 2026-10-11, not generated expectations. The three-alternative output was restored byte for byte by native Undo; native Redo restored the removed-alternative output. Both retain an independent ghost and Overflow. The integration test reopens these captured bytes in the real bundled WASM and checks typed KG synonyms through save/reopen and replayed native-history snapshots. Native UI regression evidence is in terraphim-editor PR 130; these runtime tests do not substitute for native UI acceptance.
